arxiv-2210-06340.title: Improving Radiology Report Generation Systems by Removing Hallucinated References to Non-existent Priors
arxiv-2210-06340.creator: Vignav RameshHarvard University vignavramesh@college.harvard.edu, Nathan A. ChiStanford University nchi1@stanford.edu Pranav RajpurkarHarvard Medical School pranav_rajpurkar@hms.harvard.edu
arxiv-2210-06340.description: Abstract Current deep learning models trained to generate radiology reports from chest radiographs are capable of producing clinically accurate, clear, and actionable text that can advance patient care. However, such systems all succumb to the same problem: making hallucinated references to non-existent prior reports.

arxiv-2210-15810.title: Emergence of sector and spiral patterns from a two-species mutualistic cross-feeding model
arxiv-2210-15810.creator: Jiaqi.Lin, Hui. Sun, JiaJia Dong ∗
arxiv-2210-15810.description: Abstract The ubiquitous existence of microbial communities marks the importance of understanding how species interact within the community to coexist and their spatial organization. We study a two-species mutualistic cross-feeding model through a stochastic cellular automaton on a square lattice using kinetic Monte Carlo simulation.

arxiv-2211-07298.title: Effective algebraicity for solutions of systems of functional equations with one catalytic variable
arxiv-2211-07298.creator: Hadrien Notarantonio \addressmark 1, 2, Sergey Yurkevich \addressmark 1,3
arxiv-2211-07298.description: Abstract We study systems of n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 discrete differential equations of order k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 in one catalytic variable and provide a constructive and elementary proof of algebraicity of their solutions. This yields effective bounds and a systematic method for computing the minimal polynomials.

arxiv-2410-12839.title: Capturing Bias Diversity in LLMs
arxiv-2410-12839.creator: Purva Prasad Gosavi, Vaishnavi Murlidhar Kulkarni, Alan F. Smeaton
arxiv-2410-12839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Purva Prasad Gosavi, Vaishnavi Murlidhar Kulkarni, Alan F. Smeaton. This paper presents research on enhancements to Large Language Models (LLMs) through the addition of diversity in its generated outputs. Our study introduces a configuration of multiple LLMs which demonstrates the diversities capable with a single LLM.

arxiv-2505-22145.creator: Foivos Evangelopoulos-Ntemiris, Mark Veraar
arxiv-2505-22145.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate discrete regularity estimates for a broad class of temporal numerical schemes for parabolic stochastic evolution equations. We provide a characterization of discrete stochastic maximal ℓ p \ell^{p} -regularity in terms of its continuous counterpart, thereby establishing a unified framework that yields numerous new discrete regularity results.

arxiv-2506-09152.title: Born to be Starless: Revisiting the Missing Satellite Problem
arxiv-2506-09152.creator: Seyoung Jeon, Sukyoung K. Yi, Emanuele Contini, Yohan Dubois, San Han, Katarina Kraljic, Sebastien Peirani, Christophe Pichon, Jinsu Rhee
arxiv-2506-09152.description: Abstract The massive Local Group galaxies both host substantially fewer satellites than the subhalos expected from the cold dark matter paradigm, and the recent investigations have highlighted the interplay between baryons and dark matter. We investigate the processes that make subhalos starless, using high-resolution cosmological simulations.

pmc-11690059.title: A NOVEL TIME USE APPROACH ON SUCCESSFUL AGING: RACIAL AND GENDER DISPARITIES IN DAILY PRODUCTIVE ENGAGEMENT
pmc-11690059.creator: Jason Wong, Siyao Lu, Yifan Lou, Emma Zang, Deborah Carr
pmc-11690059.description: Background and ObjectivesProductive engagement (PE) represents a potential pathway toward successful aging (SA). Using time diary data, this study explored how U.S. older adults structure their daily lives in different productive roles, the impacts of these roles on one specific dimension of SA (self-rated health), and the extent to which these patterns differ by race and gender.

pmc-12426198.title: IgG4-related disease presenting with retroperitoneal fibrosis and hypertrophic spinal pachymeningitis: a rare case report and literature review
pmc-12426198.creator: Jianchun Wang, Feifan Xu, Hongzhou Duan, Juan Zhao, Haoze Zhang, Jingru Ren, Zhenyu Niu, Feng Gao, Siwei Chen, Ran Liu
pmc-12426198.description: BackgroundHypertrophic spinal pachymeningitis (HSP) and retroperitoneal fibrosis (RPF) are rare inflammatory disorders, often associated with immunoglobulin G4-related disease (IgG4-RD). This case underscores the diagnostic intricacies and therapeutic challenges in a patient with overlapping neurological and systemic manifestations.Case presentationA 34-year-old female presented with concurrent RPF and HSP leading to urinary tract obstruction and progressive spinal cord compression.

pmc-12431147.title: A Dual-Transducer Approach for High-Resolution and High-Precision Shear Wave Elasticity Imaging
pmc-12431147.creator: Jingfei Liu, Stanislav Y Emelianov, Ming Zhu, Dipen N Sinha
pmc-12431147.description: Shear wave elasticity imaging, an ultrasound-based method for imaging tissue elasticity, has been widely accepted in both preclinical studies and clinical practices for diagnosing various diseases. Currently, shear wave elasticity imaging is primarily implemented using a single-transducer approach, in which the same ultrasound transducer is used for both generating and recording shear waves in target tissue.

pmc-12439576.title: The construction of a prognostic nomogram model for colorectal cancer and the prediction of immune characteristics and immune treatment responses based on the bioinformatics analysis of soluble mediator-related genes
pmc-12439576.creator: Leilei Yang, Xiuying Yang, Chengfeng Fang, Jiaju Han, Zhiqing Ji, Ruili Zhang, Shenkang Zhou
pmc-12439576.description: Accurate prognosis prediction in colorectal cancer (CRC) is essential for personalized treatment. Soluble mediators are promising predictive biomarkers for evaluating outcomes. We sourced transcriptome data of CRC (COAD+READ) from TCGA and GEO. Soluble mediator-related genes (SMRGs) were identified via GeneCards. Through univariate Cox and Lasso regression analyses, prognosis-related feature genes were determined.

pmc-13062021.title: GFD analysis for BRE zeolite graph through reverse degree and reverse neighborhood degree based topological descriptors
pmc-13062021.creator: K Yogalakshmi, D Easwaramoorthy, G Muhiuddin, Nabilah Abughazalah, Vladimir Kulish
pmc-13062021.description: Zeolites are minerals that are hydrated aluminosilicate and have a consistent pore structure. The zeolite family will be enhanced by the topological descriptors of molecular structures, which will also minimize the high labor costs involved in generating novel structures and lessen the environmental problems related to the industrial mass production of zeolites.

pmc-13249792.title: Magnetic, thermal and rotational evolution of isolated neutron stars
pmc-13249792.creator: José A Pons, Clara Dehman, Daniele Viganò
pmc-13249792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The strong magnetic fields of neutron stars are closely linked to their observed thermal, spectral, and timing properties, such as the distribution of spin periods and their derivatives. To understand the evolution of astrophysical observables over time, it is essential to develop robust theoretical frameworks and numerical models that solve the coupled thermal and magnetic field evolution equations, incorporating detailed microphysics such as thermal and electrical conductivities and neutrino emission rates.

pmc-13336263.title: Piperine reverses colistin resistance in multidrug resistant Gram-negative pathogens by membrane disruption and ROS damage
pmc-13336263.creator: Junkai Zhang, Qiange Liu, Haotian Shao, Mengjing Feng, Zibo Li, Yameng Feng, Hua Wu, Dandan He, Yajun Zhai, Gong-Zheng Hu
pmc-13336263.description: The global spread of colistin (COL) resistance, particularly mediated by mcr-1, threatens the efficacy of this last-line antibiotic against multidrug-resistant (MDR) Gram-negative pathogens. This development underscores the urgency of developing innovative therapeutic strategies to counteract antimicrobial resistance mechanisms. This study demonstrates that piperine (PIP), a natural alkaloid, functions as a potent adjuvant that restores COL efficacy through a multi-target mechanism.

pmc-13420526.title: Adoption and Use of a Smart Home Connected Care System by Older Adults: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-13420526.creator: Laura Pemberton, Michelle Carter, Nikolay Mehandjiev, Hanna Köttl, Xupin Zhang, Machiko Tomita
pmc-13420526.description: BackgroundSmart home technologies are often promoted as a means to support independent living and alleviate pressure on health and care systems. However, adoption among older adults remains low, and little is known about how passive, ambient technologies are experienced over time.

pmc-13499687.title: Exploring barriers and facilitators to shared decision-making for older adults in East Asian health systems: a scoping review
pmc-13499687.creator: Seung Eun Lee, Misun Hwang, Yun Jiang
pmc-13499687.description: Background and ObjectivesShared decision-making (SDM) is a core component of patient-centered care, yet evidence on SDM among older adults is largely derived from Western healthcare systems. Given sociocultural differences in East Asian contexts, particularly regarding family involvement, the transferability of Western SDM models remains uncertain.

pmc-13561715.title: Optimize human sperm cryopreservation: influence of vial sealing methods and automated freezing protocols on preserved sperm quality
pmc-13561715.creator: Pauline Haase, Steffen Rausch, Moritz Maas, Simon Walz, Jörg Hennenlotter, Maria Luisa Barcena, Arnulf Stenzl, Igor Tsaur, Viktoria Stühler
